About

Digital Fashion & Game Artist working at the intersection of real-time 3D and luxury fashion visualization. I build worlds where garments have lore, characters wear identity, and fashion becomes a design system.

R&D experience at Delvaux Brussels — embedded in the Avatar Innovation Project, delivering production-validated 3D packshots for global VIC clientele. Recognized by CLO3D for professional-grade digital fashion work.

Currently entering Gobelins — Advanced Game Creation & Real-Time Application. The convergence point: costumes designed for characters, fashion systems built for game worlds.
